cohort: The study included pregnant women with ACTD (SLE, APS, UCTD) and a control group of contemporaneous deliveries.
finding: SLE conferred an increased risk for adverse perinatal outcomes, including higher rates of vascular malperfusion, inflammatory-immune lesions, and other placental lesions compared to controls, with elevated placental histopathology risk observed across most women with ACTD.
mod_finding: SLE pregnant women had a significantly higher rate of cesarean section (61.40%) compared to the control group (p = 0.008).
birth_weight: Implicitly indicated by Small for Gestational Age (SGA)
gest_age: Implicitly indicated by premature birth and Small for Gestational Age (SGA)
